_about: T-210 batch 2 (DRAFT, built in the 2026-10-02 goal loop at the user's request): the five Hoenn water families, named by their own type's register (vision.md 2.9). Each: vanilla species, our name, INDEX category, CONTENT (what it does), CONTEXT (what follows).

daemons.name: TANGENT
content: It flies the way the slope points
from wherever it happens to be. It
never looks further than that.
context: It is right about here. It has no
idea about anywhere else, and it
flies there anyway.

daemons.name: JACOBIAN
content: Its bill holds every direction at
once, one for each way it could be
pushed. It delivers all of them.
context: Ask it which way to go and it hands
you everything it is carrying.
Choosing is still your job.

daemons.name: UNDERTOW
content: It moves under the surface, where
nobody can see which way it goes.
Things near it drift and never know.
context: Swimmers feel only that they are
further out than they meant to be.

daemons.name: RIPTIDE
content: Fast and narrow, it carries anything
straight out. Fighting it head-on
is how most of them get lost.
context: The way out is to go sideways.
Nothing about it tells you that.

daemons.name: SADDLE
content: Everything around it is level, so it
never moves. Most pass it by. It is
the least admired thing in the water.
context: It looks as if it has stopped. It
has only not been pushed the right
way yet.

daemons.name: OPTIMUM
content: Nothing anywhere is lower or calmer
than where it rests. It is said to be
the most beautiful thing in any lake.
context: It was the plain one, once. Those
who waited for it remember. Most
did not wait.

daemons.name: SEEPAGE
content: It works down through the soil and
comes up somewhere else. It feels
the ground move before anyone does.
context: It is in everything underfoot. You
only notice it when it is gone.

daemons.name: AQUIFER
content: It holds a lake inside the rock and
guards it. When it stirs, the ground
above it shakes.
context: Whole towns drink from it and have
never seen it. It remembers every
rain.

daemons.name: BACKFLOW
content: It swims backward, against the way
the water runs, and grips whatever
it meets. It is hard to dislodge.
context: Put somewhere new, it takes over the
whole stream. Nobody planned that.

daemons.name: BLACKWATER
content: The water around it turns dark, so
nothing can see what it is doing.
It sheds its shell and grows harder.
context: It does not hide. It is simply
impossible to see into, and it
prefers it that way.
